title: Pan-Seared Sea Scallops with Lemon Garlic Butter
ingredients: 1 lb large dry-packed sea scallops (about 10–12 scallops), side muscle removed
1 tbsp high-smoke-point neutral oil (avocado or grapeseed)
1 tbsp finely chopped fresh parsley or chives
Coarse kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Thoroughly pat dry the scallops between paper towels for 10 minutes — removing surface moisture is critical for a deep golden crust.
Heat neutral oil in a stainless-steel or cast-iron skillet over high heat until shimmering and just smoking.
Season scallops with kosher salt and place in the pan clockwise without crowding. Sear undisturbed for 90–120 seconds until a deep mahogany crust forms.
Flip scallops, immediately add butter, smashed garlic, and thyme, and baste scallops with the foaming brown butter for 60 seconds. Finish with fresh lemon juice and parsley.
